Movie.description: A team of explorers travels through a newly discovered wormhole near Saturn in an attempt to ensure humanity's survival beyond the dying Earth, confronting gravitational time dilation and cosmic singularities.
In a dystopian neo-Tokyo bathed in rain and neon holograms, a rogue cyber-detective uncovers an artificial intelligence consciousness plotting the digital transcendence of mankind.
A spellbinding fantasy odyssey following an immortal warrior bound by an ancient oath to protect the sacred tree of life against cosmic darkness encroaching from forgotten dimensions.

Paul Atreides unites with Chani and the Fremen while seeking revenge against the conspirators who destroyed his family. Facing a choice between the love of his life and the fate of the known universe.
A vibrant modern romantic drama about two ambitious musicians whose paths cross on the streets of Mumbai and Florence, creating unforgettable symphonies and navigating passionate love.
An undercover intelligence operative is disavowed after uncovering a nuclear conspiracy deep inside European financial institutions. He has 48 hours to clear his name.
When an estranged family inherits an aristocratic estate isolated in the Scottish highlands, they discover ancestral secrets and supernatural entities trapped behind the mirrors.
A mild-mannered cafe owner in a quiet hill town is drawn into a brutal gang war when ruthless mobsters mistake him for an elusive underworld assassin with a bloody past.

Review.reviewText: An absolute masterpiece of cinematic grandeur! The Hans Zimmer score combined with Nolan's visuals in IMAX is life-changing.
Visually stunning and narratively gripping from the very first frame. The sound design shook the entire theatre.
Outstanding cinematic experience! Visuals and audio fidelity are unbelievable.
